name: volca kick
about: A monophonic analogue kick generator with a resonator, played by notes.
source: KORG volca kick MIDI Implementation, Version 1.00 (2016.07.29), https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/726/3441/ ; MIDI Implementation Chart https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/726/3305/ ; Owner's Manual https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/726/3248/
notes: Set the global parameter MIDI RX ShortMessage to On (the factory default) or the CCs are ignored. Clock, Start, Stop and Continue are received only when MIDI Clock Src is Auto (the factory default). There is no MIDI Out: nothing is transmitted. Notes 0-127 with velocity are received. The MIDI channel is set by holding MEMORY while powering on and pressing step button 1-16; the documents do not state the factory channel, so 1 is assumed.
